text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! What should we ride next?
The Ferris wheel? The roller coaster??

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Mayano, look over there, over there!
I found something marvelous~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"VR Pilot: Fly High"!?
That sounds super fun! Let's do it, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"—Now then, pilots!
Evade enemy fire, and I pray for your safe return!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoosh! Too slow, too slow!
Maya's not gonna fall for a trap like that~??

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing☆ Being able to predict
everyone's moves makes you like a psychic★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh? If I just imagine what everyone's looking at,
I'll pretty much know what to do—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, what?
Could I actually use this in races... to!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelouuus☆ That was so much fun~★
What should we do next??

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry, Mave-chin!
Maya is super in the mood to race right now!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Just now, it clicked in my head! And I want to try it out in a race!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! A challenge letter?!
That's so very Marvelous☆ Challenge accepted～★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waah! Thank youuu~!
Alright alright, let's head back to the academy!

Putting her inspiration from the attraction to the test,
Mayano Top Gun's running style
gained a whole new level of sharpness!
